verdict.rationale: Bun's package manager is a locally run CLI that installs packages into the user's own filesystem and cache. It is not a hosted service holding user data, so choosing a cloud storage region or residency is a category error for this kind of product. The configurable local cache path (BUN_INSTALL_CACHE_DIR) is a local filesystem setting, not data residency, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
